name: MAGMA
recent: Magma 近期终止了 RM60.9m 的 Luma Hotel 收购计划，并完成了以 RM63m 出售 Heritage Lane 20% 股权的交易。公司同时通过私募分批集资约 RM23m，并拟以 RM2.8m 收购 Christine's Bakery 相关资产。最新季度（2026年3月31日止）营收环比大增但录得净亏损。
notable: 终止以 RM60.9m 收购 Luma Hotel 的拟议交易。
完成以 RM63m 出售 Heritage Lane 20% 股权予 Harum Aspirasi。
拟以 RM2.8m 现金收购 Magma Christine（Christine's Bakery 相关业务）。
risks: 私募新股分批发行，可能摊薄现有股东持股。
最新季度录得净亏损 RM7.29m，净利率为 -116.5%。
董事在闭门期内有交易持股的意向申报。
earnings: 2026年3月31日止季度营收为 RM6.261m，环比增长 235.2%，同比微降 1.2%；净亏损 RM7.294m，净利率 -116.5%，而上一季度净利率为 19.0%。

recent_en: Magma recently terminated the RM60.9m Luma Hotel acquisition and completed the RM63m disposal of its 20% stake in Heritage Lane. The company also raised about RM23m via private placement in tranches and proposed a RM2.8m acquisition of Christine's Bakery-related assets. The latest quarter (ended 31 March 2026) saw a sharp QoQ revenue increase but a net loss.
notable_en: Terminated the proposed RM60.9m acquisition of Luma Hotel.
Completed the RM63m disposal of a 20% stake in Heritage Lane to Harum Aspirasi.
Proposed a RM2.8m cash acquisition of Magma Christine (Christine's Bakery-related business).
risks_en: The private placement of new shares in tranches may dilute existing shareholders.
The latest quarter recorded a net loss of RM7.29m with a net margin of -116.5%.
Directors filed intentions to deal in securities during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 March 2026, revenue was RM6.261m, up 235.2% QoQ but down 1.2% YoY; net loss was RM7.294m with a net margin of -116.5%, versus a net margin of 19.0% in the prior quarter.
